newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Feb 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Boston University conferred prestigious Doctor of Laws, honoris causa, on Prime Ministrer Sheikh Hasina.
Brunei has expressed willingness to recruit manpower from Bangladesh.
The Dhaka City Corporation has asked the hawkers and vendors to leave pavements after the Eid ul Fitr for smooth plying of vehicles.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Friday greeted Pakistan Muslim League leader Nawaz Sharif for his victory in the national elections.
Opposition leader and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia has expressed concern that increasing incidents of extortion and terrorism were seriously disrupting economic activities.
Finance Minister S A M S Kibria has asked government officials to speed up implementation of development programmes.
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has approved inclusion of 100 more members in the Chittagong Stock Exchange.
Some 122 companies from 24 foreign countries are expected to participate in the Dhaka International Trade Fair beginning on February 22.
